title: Jesus Before the Sanhedrin
description: Jesus is brought before the high priest and the entire Council. False witnesses accuse him, including claiming he said he would destroy the temple and rebuild it in three days, but their testimonies do not agree. When the high priest asks if he is the Messiah, Jesus confirms it and speaks of the Son of Man seated at the right hand of Power. He is found guilty of blasphemy and sentenced to death; then he is spat on, beaten, and mocked [ref:Mark 14:53-14:65|Markus 14:53-14:65].
